# WINE Hair Boutique

> > WINE Hair Boutique is a Korean-style hair salon in Singapore specializing in authentic Korean perms, hair coloring, and premium hair treatments.

WINE Hair Boutique operates multiple locations across Singapore including AMK Hub, Hougang Mall, and central areas, offering signature services like Korean Oppa Perm, Korean Down Perm, and balayage treatments. The salon features premium Korean hair care products including Hei8 Daily Youth Renewal Hair Essence and complimentary Dyson styling with select services.
